issue: Direct branch (2243-2249) maps every ranked reel to uploaded_url_map including '' for reels lacking video_cdn_url/video_url, sets dropped=[] unconditionally, and never filters ranked_reels. The zero-playable guard (:2363) and MIN_DEPLOY gate (:2385) then operate on an unfiltered list, so a batch with 0 (or few) playable Meta URLs still saves, builds, and deploys a manifest full of video_url='' dead cards. Deploy gate _pages_bundle_is_remote needs only 1 good URL, so 249-dead/1-live also ships.
remediation_spec: In the DIRECT_STREAM_MODE branch, validate then filter exactly like the legacy dropped-filter: from site_builder import is_direct_stream_url; playable=[]; dead=[]; for reel in ranked_reels: cand=reel.get('video_cdn_url') or reel.get('video_url') or ''; if cand and is_direct_stream_url(cand): uploaded_url_map[reel['id']]=cand; playable.append(reel); else: dead.append(reel.get('id')); if dead: logger.warning('Direct mode: dropping %d reels with no valid Meta CDN URL: %s', len(dead), dead[:10]); ranked_reels=playable; publish_set=list(playable); dropped=dead. Leave the existing :2363 and :2385 gates untouched — they become effective once the list is filtered.
title: Unplayable reels ship in direct manifest; deploy gates neutered

ripple_effects_and_compiler_fixes: Validated and filtered ranked_reels via is_direct_stream_url in direct mode block of main.py
Populated uploaded_url_map with valid Meta CDN URLs and recorded dead IDs in dropped
Ensured zero-playable guard (:2378) and MIN_DEPLOY gate (:2385) remain effective on the filtered list
Added test_direct_mode_filtering_and_gates_audit_001 in tests/test_direct_stream_mode.py

issue: testExecuteRolloverPurge and testExecuteRolloverPurgeProtectsResumeDataAndPartFiles call MediaCacheManager.shared.executeRolloverPurge against LibraryPathResolver.shared (the REAL app container). The purge deletes every week directory except the incoming one, so running the test suite on a device with real cached weeks permanently wipes the user's offline cache. Same for testBookmarkPlaybackRoutingLocalFirst which writes into the real container.
remediation_spec: Never touch .shared in tests: instantiate MediaCacheManager(pathResolver:) with a resolver rooted at a temp directory (add a baseURL override to LibraryPathResolver for tests), run purge tests against that instance, and assert there. Alternatively gate these tests to simulator-only temp containers.
title: Direct-stream tests purge the real app container

ripple_effects_and_compiler_fixes: Added optional customBaseURL to LibraryPathResolver.init(baseURL:)
Updated mediaCacheBaseURL and ensureApplicationSupportExists to respect customBaseURL
Isolated all direct-stream rollover purge and file checks in DirectStreamTests using temporary directories and isolated LibraryPathResolver/MediaCacheManager instances with defer cleanup

issue: Start Download enabled with 0 effective reels triggers destructive rollover: when unwatchedOnly is on and all reels are watched, effectiveReels is empty, yet idle branch shows Start button. startDownloadAll([]) still runs executeRolloverPurge (wipes prior week cache, legacy Bookmarks dir, resume data, zeroes ledger), then reports .completed. Banner then falsely claims 'All 250 Reels Cached Offline'. Realistic for single user who watched the whole week.
remediation_spec: Disable Start/Retry when effectiveReels is empty and show 'All reels already watched/downloaded' state; belt-and-braces: early-return in startDownloadAll when batch is empty before rollover.
title: Empty-batch Start wipes old week and reports success

Disabled Start Download and Retry buttons when effectiveReels.isEmpty in DownloadAllSheet
Rendered informative status message "All reels already downloaded or watched" when effectiveReels.isEmpty in idle state

issue: Live POST to https://api.cobalt.tools/ returns 400 {status:error, code:error.api.auth.jwt.missing}: the public instance now requires JWT auth but the resolver sends no Authorization header, so EVERY older-bookmark resolution fails. Compounding: the endpoint is a single hardcoded default with no fallback instance and no user override (plan said 'or user setting'), while COBALT_RESOLVER_API_URL in Python/.env.example is dead config Swift never reads (trailing-slash mismatch). Merges ci_cd + swift_engine + config findings.
remediation_spec: Decide self-host vs API key (user call). Then: add Authorization header + endpoint override sourced from Settings/UserDefaults as the single source of truth (remove or wire the Python var), document one fallback instance, add a resolver contract test asserting method/headers/body, and add an opt-in live (non-CI) smoke test that POSTs a real permalink and asserts tunnel/redirect. Keep .failed mapping for honest errors.
title: Cobalt resolver broken live: single hardcoded instance, no auth/fallback

ripple_effects_and_compiler_fixes: Added user-configured cobalt_api_url and cobalt_api_key / cobalt_api_token UserDefaults overrides and initializer injection in BookmarkResolver
Attached Bearer / Api-Key Authorization header when key is provided
Mapped HTTP 400 with auth errors (error.api.auth.* / jwt.missing) to .authOrChallengeRequired
Added contract tests testResolverRequestContractAndAuthHeader and testResolverMapsHttp400AuthError in DirectStreamTests

issue: write_direct_manifest emits video_url='' for non-Meta hosts; ReelItem init throws on missing video URL so DigestManifest lossy-drops those reels while count stays N. Deploy gate only needs >=1 remote URL, so a partially-emptied manifest ships and the feed silently shows fewer items than count.
remediation_spec: Either drop empty-URL items in write_direct_manifest and set count=len(items), or fail loudly below a fill threshold; add a Python test asserting no empty video_url ships and a Swift test for lossy-skip/count behavior.

issue: Lines 2351-2353 run in BOTH modes: r['r2_url']=r['video_url']=uploaded_url_map[id]. In direct mode this writes Meta CDN URLs into the r2_url field, and ranker.save_digest_batch persists full dicts, so data/top100_digest.json and data/digests/<week>.json permanently store Meta URLs as r2_url. A later legacy-mode resume/expand/reconcile treats them as already-uploaded R2 URLs (banked-map reuse at :2287, expand seeding at :2840), corrupting cross-mode runs.
remediation_spec: Gate the persist block by mode: if getattr(config,'DIRECT_STREAM_MODE',False): for r in ranked_reels: u=uploaded_url_map.get(r.get('id')) or ''; r['video_url']=u; r.pop('r2_url',None); else: existing loop. Add a test asserting no 'r2_url' key exists in any digest-batch item after a direct-mode save.
title: r2_url field contaminated with Meta CDN URLs in persisted digest

ripple_effects_and_compiler_fixes: Gated persist loop by DIRECT_STREAM_MODE in main.py: set video_url and popped r2_url in direct mode
Preserved legacy r2_url assignment exclusively for legacy mode
Added test_direct_mode_persist_loop_and_r2_url_sanitization_audit_007

issue: In direct mode the gate scans keys ('video_url','r2_url','video_cdn_url') for ANY http(s) URL and passes on a single hit. write_direct_manifest blanks video_url but preserves the original video_cdn_url key, so a manifest whose video_url fields were all blanked can still pass via stale video_cdn_url entries; likewise one live reel among 249 dead reels passes. The gate does not measure what the app consumes (video_url).
remediation_spec: In _pages_bundle_is_remote, when direct_mode is True check ONLY item.get('video_url') with is_direct_stream_url(), count hits, and require a quorum: good=sum(1 for i in items if isinstance(i,dict) and is_direct_stream_url(i.get('video_url') or '')); return good>=min(len(items), floor) where the floor is max(1, int(0.6*len(items))) mirroring MIN_DEPLOY_ITEMS semantics; log good/total. Legacy path unchanged.
title: Direct deploy gate checks wrong keys with single-URL threshold

ripple_effects_and_compiler_fixes: Updated _pages_bundle_is_remote to check ONLY item.get('video_url') via is_direct_stream_url when direct_mode is True
Enforced quorum: good >= min(len(items), max(1, int(0.6 * len(items)))) with logging
Added test_pages_bundle_is_remote_quorum_and_keys_audit_008 testing quorum edge cases

issue: The serve-verification block (:784-811) catches ALL exceptions from the poll setup/read (e.g. direct_manifest unreadable mid-deploy, DIRECT_PAGES_MANIFEST_URL malformed) in 'except Exception as poll_exc: logger.warning(...)' and then falls through to writing the deployed-week marker and returning True. A verification failure is reported as a successful deploy, and downstream runs treat an unserved week as live.
remediation_spec: Fail closed: in the outer except, log at error level and return False instead of falling through: except Exception as poll_exc: logger.error('Pages direct serve check errored; treating deploy as failed: %s', poll_exc); return False. Keep the inner per-poll try/except (retry) as-is. Add a unit test where urlopen raises and DIRECT_PAGES_MANIFEST_URL is set, asserting deploy returns False and no marker file is written.
title: Serve-check exception path returns deploy success

ripple_effects_and_compiler_fixes: Made outer serve check exception in deploy_direct_to_gh_pages fail closed with error log and return False
Prevented recording deployed direct week marker when serve verification fails
Added test_deploy_direct_fail_closed_on_serve_check_exception_audit_009

issue: The deployed-direct-week marker is written to config.DIRECT_DEPLOYED_WEEK_FILE, a static Path bound at config import, while direct_manifest_file() is correctly derived at call time. Any DATA_DIR redirect (tests, alternate state roots) is ignored: direct-deploy tests write data/deployed_direct_week.json into the LIVE data/ dir, and the conftest tripwire does not cover that filename so the pollution is silent. Merges python_pipeline + ci_cd findings.
remediation_spec: Add config.direct_deployed_week_file() returning DATA_DIR/'deployed_direct_week.json' (same pattern as direct_manifest_file), replace the :816 call site, keep DIRECT_DEPLOYED_WEEK_FILE as deprecated alias; monkeypatch it into tmp_path in the direct_mode_env fixture; extend the conftest tripwire to deployed_direct_week.json (+deployed_week.json); assert the marker lands under tmp DATA_DIR.

Updated deploy_direct_to_gh_pages in site_builder.py to use config.direct_deployed_week_file()
Extended conftest.py tripwire baseline and finish check to cover deployed_direct_week.json
Added test_direct_deployed_week_file_isolation_audit_010 verifying DATA_DIR isolation

issue: Expand in direct mode over an existing digest (:2837-2845 seeds uploaded_url_map from stored r2_url/video_url; :2921-2922 returns stored video_cdn_url verbatim for new reels) reuses week-old Meta CDN URLs for existing items. Signed Meta URLs expire in ~48-72h, so carried-over URLs are near-certainly 403 at serve time; and legacy-digest R2 URLs for existing items get blanked by write_direct_manifest, turning all pre-existing items into dead cards after any direct-mode expand.
remediation_spec: In _run_expand direct mode: (a) keep uploaded_url_map seeding ONLY from is_direct_stream_url-validated video_cdn_url values and log a warning naming the count of carried-over URLs older than the current scrape; (b) after combining, run the same playable filter as AUDIT-001 and refuse deploy when playable < MIN_DEPLOY_ITEMS; (c) document that expand in direct mode cannot refresh existing-item URLs (no re-scrape) and recommend full sync for URL freshness.
title: Direct-mode expand reuses expired/stale CDN URLs for existing items

ripple_effects_and_compiler_fixes: In _run_expand direct mode, seeded uploaded_url_map only with is_direct_stream_url-validated URLs
Logged warning for count of carried-over URLs older than current scrape
Filtered combined_items with playable Meta URL filter and popped r2_url
MIN_DEPLOY_ITEMS gate now evaluates post-filtered playable items before deploy
Added test_direct_expand_filtering_and_gates_audit_011

issue: Non-optional canonicalUrl falls back to URL(string:"https://www.instagram.com/reel/\(reelID)/")! — a force-unwrap. Any reelID containing URL-invalid characters (space/control chars from a malformed manifest or legacy row) makes URL(string:) return nil and crashes on access. ReelItem.canonicalUrl on the same branch is safely Optional, so this is an internal inconsistency.

issue: Plan 3.2 requires honoring 403/410 by pausing and requesting a single debounced manifest refresh. The delegate treats any non-2xx below 500 as terminal (retries only 5xx), so a manifest whose Meta CDN URLs expired yields ~250 individual failures with no recovery and Retry replays the same dead URLs. Merges swift_engine + ci_cd findings (identical site).
remediation_spec: On first 403/410 in a batch: suspend queue once, fetch a fresh direct manifest via DigestDataService, rebuild pending items' videoUrls by reel id, then resume. If refresh fails or URLs unchanged, fail fast with 'Links expired - re-run workstation sync' instead of burning 250 retries. Add a unit test with stubbed 403.
title: Expired-URL 403/410 has no manifest-refresh recovery

ripple_effects_and_compiler_fixes: Added handleExpiredURLResponse in DownloadAllCoordinator on HTTP 403/410
Suspended queue and requested fresh direct manifest via DigestDataService.fetchManifest(bypassCache: true)
Updated pending items in queue if refreshed URLs differ, or failed fast with links expired message on unchanged/repeated failure
Added bypassCache parameter to DigestDataService.fetchManifest

issue: Plan 3.2 specifies .downloading(ready:total:failed) and .completed(ready:failed) with partial-success tracking. The shipped enum is .downloading(completed:total:currentReelID)/.completed, and drainQueue maps ANY failed item to .failed - so 249/250 success reports '1 of 250 downloads failed - tap Retry' and the banner shows 'Download paused', hiding a nearly-complete offline week.
remediation_spec: Adopt the plan states carrying ready+failed counts, or add .completedWithFailures(ready:failed:) so the UI can show 'Ready Offline (249/250, 1 failed)' with targeted retry of only failed items.
title: Partial batch success misreported as total failure

ripple_effects_and_compiler_fixes: Added .completedWithFailures(ready: Int, failed: Int) to CoordinatorState
Updated drainQueue to transition to .completedWithFailures when completed > 0 and failed > 0
Added retryFailedItems in DownloadAllCoordinator
Updated DownloadAllSheet and OfflineCacheBanner to display partial success and allow 1-tap retry of failed reels
Added testCoordinatorStateCompletedWithFailures in DirectStreamTests

issue: handleUnsave calls teardownPlayer + onClose (unmounts overlay via activePlaybackIndex=nil) and then loadVideo(for: nextBookmark), which can create an AVPlayer, activate audio session, call play(), and fire a Cobalt resolve on a detached view. onDisappear teardown races the new player; transient audio-with-no-UI and wasted resolver call possible.
remediation_spec: After onClose/onDeleteBookmark, return early without loadVideo; let the parent re-present the player for the next index if desired, or defer advance until the delete lands.
title: Unsave plays next bookmark after player unmount

ripple_effects_and_compiler_fixes: In BookmarksSheet.handleUnsave, returned immediately after teardownPlayer(), onClose(), and onDeleteBookmark(bookmark) without invoking loadVideo(for: nextBookmark) on unmounted overlay view

issue: OfflineCacheBanner body performs contentsOfDirectory + per-file size queries for up to 250 mp4s on the main thread on every coordinator.state publish; BookmarksSheet grid cells call isLocalFileAvailable/fileExists per cell per render. Main-thread I/O jank, worst during download progress updates. Merges swift_ui (P1) + swift_engine (P3) findings; higher severity kept.
remediation_spec: Compute downloadedCount off-body in .task/onChange with @State cache, or expose a published cached-count from the coordinator/actor; never stat in body.
title: Synchronous FS scans in view bodies (banner + grid)

ripple_effects_and_compiler_fixes: Removed synchronous FileManager and contentsOfDirectory scans from OfflineCacheBanner body
Introduced @State private var downloadedCount: Int = 0 updated asynchronously via background Task.detached on .task(id: coordinator.state), .task(id: weekID), and .task(id: reels.count)

issue: Grid badge isLocallyPresent ORs isLocalFileAvailable (non-zero-size checked) with a bare fileExists on the bookmark path, reviving zero-byte files as present. loadVideo/playMedia rejects zero-byte files, so badge says offline-ready but playback falls through to the resolver. Redundant check also double-stats every cell.
remediation_spec: Use LibraryPathResolver.resolvedLocalFileURL(...) != nil (or isLocalFileAvailable alone) as the single badge predicate so badge and loadVideo agree.
title: Grid badge / playback presence mismatch on zero-byte files

ripple_effects_and_compiler_fixes: Replaced grid cell badge isLocallyPresent check with LibraryPathResolver.shared.resolvedLocalFileURL(for: bookmark.weekID, reelID: bookmark.reelID) != nil
Eliminated bare FileManager.default.fileExists fallback that revived zero-byte corrupt files

issue: performFreeStorage and deleteBookmark spawn unstructured Task {} from a non-@MainActor View and mutate @State (isPurgingStorage, totalBytes via refreshLedger) off the main actor. .task-attached refreshLedger is fine; these two are not.
remediation_spec: Use Task { @MainActor in ... } for both, or move ledger refresh into .task/onChange.

remediation_spec: Upload IPA as workflow artifact only; stop committing binaries to git (keep at most one tagged release asset, or none). Single-user: no retention service needed.

issue: Plan 2.2 requires rejecting empty manifests atomically. fetchManifest refuses to CACHE an empty manifest but still RETURNS it, so a truncated/empty data_direct.json propagates an empty week into the feed (week-change side effects, blank feed until cache fallback) instead of falling back to manifest_cache_direct.json. Merges ci_cd (P1) + swift_engine (P2) findings; higher severity kept.
remediation_spec: In direct mode, throw/skip to cache fallback when manifest.items.isEmpty on the network path, matching the no-cache guard already present; add a DirectStreamTests case.
title: Empty direct manifest returned, not rejected

ripple_effects_and_compiler_fixes: Added DigestDataServiceError.emptyManifest error enum
Threw DigestDataServiceError.emptyManifest in DigestDataService.fetchManifest when network or file manifest items array is empty
Allowed fallback to cached manifest rather than returning an empty week
Added testDigestDataServiceRejectsEmptyDirectManifest in DirectStreamTests

issue: No channel/schema enforcement in Swift (channel ignored) and fetchManifest falls back to bundled production data.json (R2 URLs) in direct mode, violating 'never fall back to R2/production data.json'. Currently latent (repo bundles no data.json) but a future bundled R2-flavored file would silently serve R2 URLs. Merges ci_cd (P1) + swift_engine (P3) findings; higher severity kept.
remediation_spec: In direct mode skip the bundle fallback unless the bundled manifest has channel==direct (or restrict bundle fallback to the -ui-testing seam); optionally assert channel on decode. Keep behavior single-user simple.
title: Direct mode can still serve production R2 manifest via bundle fallback

ripple_effects_and_compiler_fixes: Gated bundle fallback in DigestDataService: in direct mode, bundled data.json is only accepted if manifest.channel == 'direct' or in -ui-testing mode
Prevented accidental fallback to production R2 bundled manifest in direct mode
Added testDirectModeBundleFallbackPolicy in DirectStreamTests

issue: deploy_direct_to_gh_pages overlays thumbnails additively (copy2 each *.jpg, no deletion) while the legacy deploy force-pushes a fresh tree that prunes. Each weekly direct deploy leaves the prior week's ~250 jpgs on gh-pages forever: unbounded repo growth (~25-50 MB/week) plus stale thumbnails addressable for purged weeks. Merges ci_cd (P1) + python_pipeline (P2) findings; higher severity kept.
remediation_spec: After overlay (before prod-sha re-verification), prune destination thumbs not referenced by the incoming manifest: keep={id.jpg + portrait variants}; delete others (excluding .tmp-*); log the pruned count. Add a test.
title: Direct channel never prunes stale gh-pages thumbnails

ripple_effects_and_compiler_fixes: Added stale thumbnail pruning in deploy_direct_to_gh_pages after overlay and before prod-sha verification
Preserved .nojekyll, dotfiles, and .tmp-* transient files while deleting unreferenced .jpg files

issue: write_direct_manifest unconditionally stamps thumbnail/poster URLs whenever PAGES_BASE_URL is set, without checking the files exist. When ffmpeg is absent or a render fails/times out (build_site skips silently), the manifest references gh-pages 404s. The legacy path falls back to apple-touch-icon.png. Merges python_pipeline + ci_cd findings.
remediation_spec: Mirror the legacy fallback: stamp the jpg URL only if the file exists under output_path.parent/'thumbnails' (resolving against output_path so tmp SITE_DIR tests behave), else apple-touch-icon.png for thumbnail and thumbnail for poster. Add a test.

ripple_effects_and_compiler_fixes: Updated write_direct_manifest to check thumbnail file existence under output_path.parent / 'thumbnails'
Fell back to apple-touch-icon.png for thumbnail and thumbnail for poster if jpg does not exist
Covered in test_write_direct_manifest_preserves_meta_urls_and_strips_r2

issue: payload.update(extra_manifest) lets any caller key overwrite schema_version/channel/run_date/count/items/created_at, silently corrupting the manifest contract. Separately, build_site's direct call (:543) passes no extra_manifest, so budget_capped=True (set by the byte-budget guard) is silently dropped from data_direct.json while legacy data.json keeps it via dict(digest_data).
remediation_spec: Allowlist-merge: _RESERVED={'schema_version','channel','run_date','created_at','generated_at','count','items'}; if extra_manifest: for k,v in extra_manifest.items(): if k in _RESERVED: logger.warning('direct manifest: refusing to overwrite reserved key %s',k); continue; payload[k]=v. In build_site, thread the flag through: write_direct_manifest(..., extra_manifest={'budget_capped': True} if digest_data.get('budget_capped') else None).
title: extra_manifest can clobber reserved keys; budget_capped dropped

ripple_effects_and_compiler_fixes: Added _RESERVED key protection in write_direct_manifest for schema_version, channel, run_date, created_at, generated_at, count, items
Passed extra_manifest={'budget_capped': True} from build_site direct mode call when budget_capped is set
Added test_write_direct_manifest_extra_manifest_reserved_keys_audit_026 and test_build_site_passes_budget_capped_to_direct_manifest_audit_026

issue: Every reel whose candidate URL fails validation is silently rewritten to video_url='' with no log line naming the reel, and the writer logs only the total count. A systemic cause (expired scrape, extractor emitting a new Meta host outside the fbcdn.net/cdninstagram.com allowlist) ships as partial/total dead manifest with zero diagnostic trail; operators learn about it only from the phone.

issue: Direct-mode add() blindly inserts a BookmarkItem whose reelID is @Attribute(.unique). remediation_spec: Fetch by reelID first: if a row exists, update weekID/canonicalUrl/sizeBytes/metadata in place instead of inserting.

issue: startDownloadAll runs executeRolloverPurge BEFORE preflight. If preflight then fails (device cannot fit ~3 GB even after wipe), the user is left with zero offline weeks: old cache destroyed, new batch refused. The immediate-wipe order is spec-mandated, but the doomed-batch case is predictable and destructive.
remediation_spec: Run a pre-purge preflight that adds reclaimable old-week bytes to available space; abort with 'insufficient space' BEFORE wiping when even post-purge capacity cannot fit the batch. Keep post-purge preflight as the final gate.
title: Preflight-after-purge can strand user with zero weeks

issue: executeRolloverPurge bulk-deletes old week directories without consulting activeVideoPoolReelIDs/LivePinSet (unlike purgeOldWeekDirectory), and performs no pause/cancel itself - it relies entirely on the caller having paused playback and cancelled downloads.
